services_heading: Professional Painting & Decorating Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: From full interior refurbishment to exterior protection, we handle every job with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Complete room transformation including walls, ceilings, and woodwork. We prep thoroughly and use premium finishes that last.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Protection
services.desc: Protect your home from Newcastle weather. We paint fascias, soffits, doors, and weatherboard using exterior-grade products.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Expert wallpaper hanging and removal. We source quality papers and create stunning feature walls that transform rooms.

services.title: Fencing & Garden Structures
services.desc: Paint and stain fences, sheds, and garden buildings to extend their life and enhance kerb appeal.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Office, shop, and warehouse painting completed on schedule with minimal disruption to your business.

services.title: Preparation & Remedial Work
services.desc: We don't cut corners—proper surface prep, crack repair, and damp treatment ensure a finish that lasts years.

about_pullquote: I prepare every surface properly because rushing that bit always shows.
about_para_1: Dean Coombs started in the painting trade over 15 years ago, learning from experienced decorators across the North East. Today, he runs a straightforward operation: turn up on time, do the job right, leave the place spotless. He's built his reputation by returning to the same Newcastle households and businesses because they trust the quality and the price.
about_para_2: Customers come back to Dean because he listens—he won't oversell you unnecessary work, and he'll spend time getting colour choices and finishes exactly as you imagine them. Whether it's a single bedroom refresh or a full commercial repaint, he treats every project with the same care and attention to detail.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Dean

reviews.text: Dean painted our whole lounge and hallway. He was tidy, professional, and finished on time. The walls look brilliant and he cleaned up after himself properly. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had Dean wallpaper our feature wall and paint the rest of the room. Lovely bloke, very patient when we couldn't decide on colours. Really high standard of work. Will use him again.
reviews.author: Jennifer H.

reviews.text: Needed our external doors and fascias painted before winter. Dean got it done quickly, didn't muck about, and his price was fair. No hidden extras. Top job.
reviews.author: Robert W.
